posts.community: India 2040 - the next generation of structural compounders
posts.text: India 2040 is not a single “GDP growth” trade; it is a multi-decade capital-allocation test. The strongest structural compounders should sit where large demand pools, policy support, export optionality, technology depth, high incremental ROCE, clean governance, and valuation discipline overlap. India’s manufacturing push is now backed by PLI schemes across 14 sectors with ₹1.97 lakh crore outlay, and the government reports realised PLI investments of ~₹1.76 lakh crore by March 2025 and participant sales above ₹16.5 lakh crore.
